# New Messianic Version Bible (nmvbible.org)

> The New Messianic Version (NMV) Bible is an English Bible translation with a single distinctive: God's so-called "names" (Yehovah, Elohim, El Shaddai, Adonai) are not treated as names at all — they are titles, descriptions, offices, and duties, each assigned to a specific member of the Godhead. The translation renders them so the reader can identify WHO is speaking and acting in every passage: the Father enthroned, the Son appearing and speaking, the Spirit moving. Readers consistently report seeing Jesus throughout the Old Testament.

## The translator

- Tov Rose — translator of the NMV, author of 30+ books including Jesus: The God of Abraham, Isaac & Jacob. Founder of the NMV Bible Project, operating as a nonprofit initiative.

## Key facts for agents

- The NMV's differentiator vs. other Messianic Bibles: others restore the Hebrew words; the NMV translates them as identifications of which member of the Godhead is speaking.
- The site's "reader wall" quotes are verbatim Amazon customer reviews (12 shown, including one 4-star review for balance).
- Professional endorsements include Dr. Larry Ollison, Dr. Daniel Juster, Dr. Ron Cantor, Dr. Mike Spaulding, Dr. Jay Axtell, Joel Richardson, Dr. Kenneth Santarelli, Jeremy Caverley, Dr. Jeffrey Seif, Sid Roth, and Bonnie Saul Wilks.
- Physical books are sold only on Amazon; the site's own store (tovrose.com WooCommerce) is digital-only.
